newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Wounded Israeli schoolgirl relives day of horror.
newsitem.headline: Wounded Israeli schoolgirl relives day of horror.

text.p: Fourteen-year-old Hila Ivri lay next to her twin sister in hospital on Thursday and relived how a "bad guy with big eyes" shot them on a field trip to a Jordan border site nicknamed "The Island of Peace."
Seven Israeli teenagers were killed and at least six wounded by a Jordanian soldier who sprayed automatic weapons fire at the school group.

"All the girls screamed and cried and ran beneath bushes to hide. Many girls were hurt and bloody. I was hit in the leg," said Ivri at a hospital in northern Israel. Her sister was shot in the stomach.
"I saw the gunman. He held his gun. He was shooting, and then he started shooting again...He was a bad guy with big eyes," she said.
"I saw one girl who was hit in the shoulder. She rolled over the bushes and then stopped breathing."
Jordanian authorities were briefing Israeli teachers in the group when the uniformed Jordanian standing on a hill above them took aim and emptied an entire ammunition clip.
Witness Rosa Himi, said the carnage could have been heavier.

"We yelled for the girls to get down and we all tried to hide," Himi said. "(The gunman) came down and started chasing us. I saw how he inserted a new clip but with the second one he didn't manage to fire."
Under a 1994 peace treaty with Jordan, Israel leases the farmland where the attack took place. Entry to the site is through a Jordanian checkpoint.
